svg.title: Castle upstairs accommodation map
svg.desc: A warm, hand-drawn upstairs plan of the Castle. Storage and rooms 1 to 4 run across the upper wing, with bathrooms between rooms 2 and 3. Room 3 has three single beds and Room 4 has five single beds. Kitchen and dining are at lower left and the ballroom and open space are central. Beneath Room 4, table football and ping pong span the top, with shower and WC image-left and the hall image-right. Rooms 5 and 6 sit underneath; Room 6 has one double bed. Select a room to open its photo and details.

g.text: TAP A ROOM FOR ITS PHOTO ↗ · NOT TO SCALE
